[[Ebon Vanguard Scout]]s are [[NPC]]s that provides the [[Vanguard Patrol]] blessing. When first talked to, with at least 25 kills, you receive a [[Vanguard Patrol#Random bonuses|bonus]]. When awarded bonus reputation points, the bonus is greater with more kills.

==Locations==
* [[Charr Homelands]]
** [[Dalada Uplands]]
** [[Grothmar Wardowns]]
** [[Sacnoth Valley]]

==Dialogue==
=== Not under [[Vanguard Patrol]] ===
==== In Grothmar Wardowns ====
;Outside Ooze Pits
: ''"Hail, and well met! You're one of those adventurers, aren't you? I recognize your type. I know you folk are usually looking for things to do, and have I got a job for you. The creatures all over this land have got to be eradicated. If you'll help, I'll share these marching orders with you to make the job go faster."'' 
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Killing: it's not just a job, it's an adventure.
| accepticon = [[File:Vanguard Patrol.jpg|20px]]
| decline = If you're a scout, why are you always standing here.
| ask = Ascalon isn't lost forever. She's still waiting for us. We just have to find the way home. Maybe we need more heroes.
}}

;In Grothmar, near exit to Sacnoth Valley
: ''"Hail, and well met! You're one of those adventurers, aren't you? Well, Captain Langmar has ordered us to eradicate creatures in the area. Would you like to assist?"''
{{Offer dialog
| accept = I'm always happy to help out the Vanguard
| accepticon = [[File:Vanguard Patrol.jpg|20px]]
| decline = I need to see a Norn about an ooze
| ask = There's no time to argue. Just get out there and do what you can. That's all any of us can do, in the end.
}}

==== In Dalada Uplands ====
;South of Molotov Rocktail
:''"Before we can even be assigned to any real duty, we have to prove ourselves by killing all these creatures. Might you be interested in killing a few for us? We'll never forget your service, and we'll share Captain Langmar's orders to give you a head start!"''
{{Offer dialog
| accept = Anything for the sons and daughters of Ascalon.
| accepticon = [[File:Veteran Vanguard Patrol.jpg|20px]]
| decline = "Prove yourself" generally means "do it yourself."
| ask = I just want to leave this place and get back to the front. They need every sword they can get...
}}

;Northeast of Molotov Rocktail
:''"They say you're a miracle worker, born from [[Dwayna]]'s breath. If so, we could use one...a miracle. The creatures roaming these lands are becoming too much for our reserves to fight, and we can't afford to take any men off the front line. Captain Langmar's asked us to clear them out. Grab a set of orders and get cracking."''
{{Offer dialog
| accept = Ask and ye shall receive.
| accepticon = [[File:Veteran Vanguard Patrol.jpg|20px]]
| decline = I don't trade in miracles.
| ask = There's no reason to yell at anyone. We're all doing our best to survive and get home again.
}}

==== In Sacnoth Valley ====
;Outside Catacombs of Kathandrax and Rragar's Menagerie
:''"At last, a friendly face! These lands are perilous, and we cannot return home until they are clear. Would you be willing to lend a hand while you're out here, adventurer? I'll even give you my conscription orders from Captain Langmar...they'll help you!
{{Offer dialog
| accept = I've done this kind of thing before.
| accepticon = [[File:Veteran Vanguard Patrol.jpg|20px]]
| decline = I don't take orders.
| ask = The sooner the creatures die, the sooner we can get back to retaking Ascalon.
}}

;On west and north sides of the burning forest
:''"Be careful. These lands are overrun and we are spread too thin to protect you, friend. In fact, if you're an adventurer and would care to help out, I'd be grateful and so would the whole Vanguard. Dwayna be with you, but take this, too. Can't be too careful."''
{{Offer dialog
| accept = The Ebon Vanguard has my assistance.
| accepticon = [[File:Veteran Vanguard Patrol.jpg|20px]]
| decline = Sorry, I'm pressed for time.
| ask = The Ebon Vanguard is spread so thin we can barely protect the survivors of Ascalon, much less retake the lands we've lost.
}}
